in_hebrew.name: הלימדה
in_hebrew.meaning: חליפת הים, השם פירושו החלפה של הים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם הלימדה הוא שילוב של המילים 'חליפת' ו'ים', ופירושו החלפה של הים. הוא נגזר מהשפה היוונית ומשמש כסמל לתמורה ושינוי בים או בחיים.

in_greek.name: Αλημίδα
in_greek.meaning: Αλλαγή της θάλασσας, το όνομα σημαίνει αλλαγή στη θάλασσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλημίδα προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει αλλαγή στη θάλασσα. Είναι σύμβολο της αλλαγής και της μεταμόρφωσης στη ζωή ή στη θάλασσα.

data.cultural_impact: The name Halimeda, although not directly found in the Bible or in Christian tradition, is a beautiful variation of the biblical name Hagar. It evokes images of the strong and resourceful desert woman, who despite the harsh conditions, was able to provide for her child and become the mother of a great nation, the Arab people. Halimeda represents a connection to the rich Middle Eastern cultural heritage that influences Christian theology through the Old Testament.
data.spiritual_significance: Halimeda, as a name rooted in Hebrew and Biblical tradition, serves as a reminder of the power and faithfulness of God. The name signifies resilience and resourcefulness, attributes that can be drawn from the story of Hagar and her son Ishmael. It also highlights the idea of generosity, as Hagar was able to provide for her son in the unforgiving desert. Halimeda can serve as an inspiration for those seeking to stay strong in their faith, even amidst adversity or difficult circumstances.
